description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the human anime style generation feature (GenerateHumanAnimeStyle)
description_zh: 本文介绍人物动漫化GenerateHumanAnimeStyle的语法及示例
name: GenerateHumanAnimeStyle

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the image. We recommend using an OSS link in the Shanghai region. For local files or OSS links in other regions, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
Image format requirements:

Image format: JPG, JPEG, or PNG.
Image size: No larger than 3 MB.
Image resolution: Greater than 32 × 32 pixels and less than 2000 × 2000 pixels. The longest side must be no more than 1999 pixels, and the face area must be at least 60 × 60 pixels.
Clear frontal face photos with one or more people are supported. The maximum number of faces is 5, and the face orientation must be within 45 degrees in any direction.
The URL must not contain Chinese characters.
Image content: If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, resize the image first. For more information, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44688.html
parameters.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
图片格式要求：

图像格式：JPG、JPEG、PNG。
图像大小：不超过3 MB。
图像分辨率：大于32×32像素，小于2000×2000像素。最长边小于等于1999像素，人脸占比不低于60×60像素。
支持有单人或多人的人脸清晰正面照，最大人脸数目限制5，人脸朝向在上下左右45度以内。
URL地址中不能包含中文字符。
图像内容：当图像分辨率超过最大限制时，请先将图片进行缩放，调整图片大小，具体请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44688.html

parameters.help_en:
The cartoon effect configuration parameter. Valid values:

anime: Japanese anime style
3d: 3D effects
handdrawn: hand-drawn style
sketch: pencil sketch
artstyle: art effects
claborate: Chinese painting style
hongkong: Hong Kong comics style
comic: comic style
animation3d: animation 3D

sketch：铅笔画
artstyle：艺术特效
claborate  ：国画工笔画
hongkong  ：港漫风

animation3d：动画3D

ImageURL.description_en:
The URL of the cartoonized result image.
This URL is a temporary address valid for 30 minutes. After expiration, the URL becomes inaccessible. To save the file for a longer period or permanently, access the URL within 30 minutes and download the file to your own OSS or other storage
ImageURL.description_zh:
人物卡通化结果图的URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间
